opis: The bright children's room from the reference picture (the same striped wallpaper, the window, the bed, the round rug, the bookcase), warm afternoon light. Beside the window hangs a long light-blue floor-length CURTAIN. The BEAR, surprised and laughing, has just pulled the curtain aside with one paw: BEHIND it stands the BUNNY, laughing with both paws up - "you found me!". In the middle of the room stands a green ARMCHAIR, and from BEHIND its back only the two round ears of a small brown TEDDY BEAR toy peek out. The small HEDGEHOG stands beside the armchair, clapping happily. Warm, cosy and funny.
